'''Tal Nethin''' was a saddlemaker from [[Taien]], a small town in the eastern end of the [[Jangai Pass]], in [[Cairhien]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tal Nethin}}

==Appearance==
He was gray-haired with a deeply creased face, and gaunt cheeks from hunger.

==Activities==
After [[Couladin]] and the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] stopped to decimate the town of Taien on their way from [[Alcair Dal]] to Cairhien, Tal Nethin approached [[Rand al'Thor]] and his group on their way into Taien. He was accompanied by his sister [[Aril Corl|Aril]] and her husband [[Ander Corl]]; all were refugees from the events in Taien. Rand chose to take the survivors of the town with him, of whom there were estimated to be one hundred. {{ref/book|5|20}}

Some time later, near [[Eianrod]], Tal tripped on a stone, breaking his neck and falling dead. Rand thought this to be an effect of his being ''[[ta'veren]]''. {{ref/book|5|30}}
